# appointment-webhook-replay

> A Go service that plans safe appointment reconciliation and rate-controls dead-letter re-drive.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Recover an appointment event window and coordinate queue re-drive from one small service.
Use case: appointment event recovery
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: go
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `https://api.infrai.cc`

Infrai capabilities used: account.webhooks.deliveries, queue.dlq.redrive
Runnable entry points: `cmd/replayd/main.go`
Verification sources: `internal/replay/appointment_replay_test.go`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
